1) ⚠ THE ROM RE-LAYOUT CANNOT BE DONE FROM AEON AT ALL, AND THE OBVIOUS ATTEMPT IS THE WRONG ONE. A `[[anchor]]` in games/sonic4/map.toml PLACES NOTHING. sigil's `true_bases_by_index` builds every section's base from `profile.frozen_sizes` -- the label->LMA rows of sigil's golden/offcanonical_sizes/<shape>.txt, read from THEIR checkout at RUN time. Anchors reach the walk only as `anchor_addrs: HashSet<u32>` matched BY ADDRESS, never by name, and can only AUTHORIZE a section to stay where the table already puts it. PROVEN BOTH DIRECTIONS: (a) anchors moved to 0xA8000/0xB8000 with tables unchanged -> `[map.undeclared-island] ROM section at 0x90000`, the bank did not move; (b) control, spare anchor at an empty address -> `[map.anchor-absent] ... is not an inferred island`, nothing landed there.
